annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting Firebending Lesson, leaving mana unused and Town Greeter alive.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Firebending Lesson targeting Town Greeter to kill it for 1 mana, adding another Lesson to the graveyard and removing the opponent's only creature.

annotations.description: Declined Artist's Talent's loot trigger when they have TWO Monument to Endurance on the battlefield. Discarding any card would have drawn a replacement card from Artist's Talent AND triggered both Monuments (giving two choices among: draw a card, create a Treasure, or opponent loses 3 life). This is substantial free value being left on the table.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose not to discard a card to Artist's Talent's trigger.
annotations.betterLine: Discard a duplicate Boomerang Basics or Accumulate Wisdom to draw a card from Artist's Talent and get two Monument to Endurance triggers (e.g., draw a card + opponent loses 3 life, or create a Treasure + draw a card).

annotations.description: Chose to create a Treasure token from Monument to Endurance when drawing a card would have provided more value. With 7 lands already in play and Artist's Talent reducing noncreature spell costs, the extra mana from a Treasure is less impactful than gaining an additional card. The hand contains only cheap spells (Boomerang Basics, Firebending Lesson, Accumulate Wisdom) that don't require extra mana to cast.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose 'Create a Treasure token' from Monument to Endurance trigger
annotations.betterLine: Choose 'Draw a card' for card advantage, since mana wasn't the bottleneck with 7 lands and cost reduction from Artist's Talent level 2

annotations.description: MiMo Trash declined to cast Accumulate Wisdom with 5 Lesson cards in graveyard, which would have drawn all 3 cards looked at instead of just 1. With untapped lands available and Artist's Talent also triggering for an additional loot, this is significant card advantage left on the table. The mana would likely go unused otherwise.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to cast any additional spells alongside the Firebending Lesson already on the stack.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Accumulate Wisdom with the remaining untapped mana to draw 3 cards (since 3+ Lessons are in graveyard), plus get an Artist's Talent loot trigger for additional card selection.

annotations.description: Player cast Wistfulness for full cost (5 mana) instead of evoking it, spending all available mana. The reasoning was based on a misunderstanding of the card (thinking it strips opponent's hand - that's Deceit, not Wistfulness). Wistfulness draws 2/discards 1 (if UU spent) or exiles an artifact/enchantment (if GG spent). Evoking for 2 mana would still get the ETB triggers while leaving 3 mana open for other plays, like playing Overgrown Tomb and holding up interaction. At 8 life with the opponent likely having burn/removal, leaving mana open is important.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Wistfulness for full cost {3}{G/U}{G/U}, using all 5 available mana to keep the 6/5 body.
annotations.betterLine: Evoke Wistfulness for {G/U}{G/U} to get the ETB trigger (draw 2 or exile an enchantment like Monument to Endurance), then play Overgrown Tomb and keep mana open for Requiting Hex or other interaction. The 6/5 body is nice but not worth tapping out at 8 life.

annotations.description: Named 'Nightmare' for Cavern of Souls, but Harvester of Misery is a Spirit, not a Nightmare. This means the Cavern cannot produce colored mana for any creature in the player's hand or graveyard, effectively making it a colorless-only land.
annotations.actionTaken: Named 'Nightmare' for Cavern of Souls, matching zero creatures in hand or deck.
annotations.betterLine: Name 'Elemental' to support casting both Deceit and Wistfulness (two Elemental Incarnations in hand) with uncounterable colored mana, or 'Spirit' for Harvester of Misery.
